question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution: The correct answer is** "descended."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Descended"** means to move or fall downward, often in a gradual manner. (नीचे आना; उतरना) • The word is commonly used to describe physical movement, such as a person descending a staircase or an object descending from a higher position. • **Example**: *Jane **descended**__ the stairs.* • **"Descended"** fits this description, as it suggests a downward movement or decline. • The correct answer is Option 4. • Correct passage: Buck __pranced__ over against the sled, __exhausted__, sobbing for breath, helpless. This was Spitz’s opportunity. He sprang upon Buck, and twice his teeth sank into his __undetermined__ foe and ripped and tore the flesh to the bone. Then Francois’ lash __**descended**__, and Buck had the satisfaction of watching Spitz receive the worst whipping as yet ______ (5) ______ to any of the team. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Defended"** means to protect or support something, often in the face of criticism or attack. ((संकट से किसी की) रक्षा करना) • **"Deteriorated" **means to become worse or less desirable over time. ((स्थिति का) बिगड़ना, बदतर होना) • **"Demeaned"** means to lower someone's status or reputation, often through verbal or social means. (अक्सर मौखिक या सामाजिक माध्यमों से किसी की स्थिति या प्रतिष्ठा को कम करना) 41:Tf30, The correct answer is **"administered."**
